summary: Full frontend regression of restructured Direct Cranes Hire site (5 services + locations + about). Home, all 5 service pages incl. embedded fleet spec sheets, prev/next cycling, locations, about, old-route redirects (fleet/projects/contact/service-areas/services/mobile-crane-hire all redirect to /), footer, and mobile viewport nav all verified. 53/53 real checks passed (3 reported 'failures' were selector mistakes in the test itself, not app bugs — verified via source + screenshot).
critical_code_review_comments: site-data.js VALUES uses n='01'/'02'/'03' — testids are about-value-01 etc. Fine but if intent was numeric 1/2/3 note that.
